cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project("FFmpeg")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MESSAGE_INDENT "[${PROJECT_NAME}] ")

streamfx_component_register("${PROJECT_NAME}")

find_package("FFmpeg"
	COMPONENTS "avutil" "avcodec" "swscale"
)
if(NOT FFmpeg_FOUND)
    streamfx_component_disable(${COMPONENT_TARGET} "FFmpeg is not available.")
    return()
else()
    target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_TARGET}
        PUBLIC
			FFmpeg::avutil
			FFmpeg::avcodec
			FFmpeg::swscale
    )
endif()
